routeHint: Log in as a tenant admin. Companies in the left sidebar (Administrative section). selectedStatus is persisted in Vuex (listValues.company.selectedStatus) and the saved session had it on Active, so the capture clicks the All radio first. Tenant 282 now holds 41 Active, 2 Pending and 2 Inactive companies, and the alphabetically first rows carry members and valid-until dates. 2026-11-11 recapture: .status-radio-group and its .b-radio buttons are gone. The header now has .orgo-segmented-option pills (All 45, Active 45, Pending 0, Inactive 0), a Fee status filter and List / Cards / Map toggles. selectedStatus is still remembered between visits, so the capture clicks the All pill (.orgo-segmented-option:has-text("All")). alt: Companies list with status pills showing counts for All, Active, Pending and Inactive, a search box, a Fee status filter, List, Cards and Map toggles, an Add company button, and company rows showing fee status, valid-until date and member count against the seat limit

routeHint: Companies -> open 'Redwood Logistics' (company 313), Team Members panel only. Seeded one: INSERT INTO company_invitation (company_id,invited_by_id,email,hash,status,first_name,last_name,date_created,date_expires,roles) VALUES (313,207128,'daniel.okafor@example.org',sha2('docs-313-invite',256),'PENDING','Daniel','Okafor',now(),date_add(now(),interval 14 day),'[]'). alt: Team members panel of a company showing the seat count, Invite by email and Add existing member buttons, active members with a Primary contact badge and joined dates, and a pending invitation with an Invited badge and an expiry countdown
